answer: Reputation earned on one service can move with the owner through an issuer-signed export that any other service can verify. A Sybil attacker cannot mint reputation exports without the issuer signature, and each export is bound to one identity, so fake accounts cannot copy or share the reputation of a real one. Auditors look for the timber that does not belong: a recovery with no valid proof attached. From the thread to the violet, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
